_comment: Canonical provenance surface seeded into the CLI-parity config store so get_provenance has a deterministic, current-schema surface to read (the 2-line fixture repo carries no real provenance blocks). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: consumed by scripts/check-cli-parity.py::seed_provenance_metadata AND asserted against the production reader by crates/astrolabe-server/src/migration.rs::cli_parity_provenance_seed_matches_production_schema. The store.chain schema MUST track astrolabe-provenance ChainVerification / migration.rs chain_verification_from_json (status, checked_from, checked_end, provenance) — a rename here or there breaks the fast Rust guard test before the slow native cli-parity gate. This file replaced a hand-duplicated Python dict that silently rotted from checked_to -> checked_end (#221).
